notes.title: The end of 2.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/8e8198e2509545f0466874e59a9dafb710b31020.png[/img]

Hello, Dungeon Warriors!

After 8 months of updates, "Dungeon No Dungeon" finally ushered in the end of version 2.0. The completion and full release of version 2.0 mean that "Dungeon No Dungeon" has completed the polishing and design of the basics in our minds. It also means that the three of us will design and improve "Dungeon No Dungeon" in a new direction. In addition, many friends have already known about our situation. We are indeed facing a very severe financial situation. In order to avoid the worst situation (unable to support ourselves), we have cut all unnecessary expenses and kept the minimum demand. I insisted on all the methods (it seems to have to eat instant noodles for a long time), and hope to solve the current financial dilemma as soon as possible in the future.

However, regardless of whether we can get out of the predicament this time, we all hope that we can continue to make games for you guys, bring joy, and strive to make a "better game". So we will not regret the result, because we have indeed worked as hard as possible! Please do not worry about our situation, and we will do everything we can to overcome the obstacles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/e1e95227152ec345cacdd9f20d56d3748560fed9.png[/img]

[h2]The contents of this update[/h2]

Let's take a look at the new changes?

[h3]Adventure mode and Arena have been merged[/h3]

We want to make the arena to be gradually strengthened and balanced in the future, and the adventure mode will be played for purely exploratory purposes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/2baaf46127dd3fb74a66e74e67ce0f9cc1497fc6.png[/img]

[h3]Achievement is separated from the message board[/h3]

We want the achievement to be used as a gameplay method, and players will have to achieve the achievement through various weird events to get rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/dc4f44ddcc1379a9dd92dfa7672c14de48a9a022.png[/img]

[h3]Arena is increased to 300 levels+[/h3]

We will further expand and balance the gameplay of the arena, and challenge its limits to obtain high rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/9150aa29bb8cfd9b0e4391869ad2c0e7c469c9eb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/15611a2baf9079f6f383155f5beba014cd126403.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/dc36f5b12d10a8879efad87689b6b52bb6733ddb.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] Improved the effect of some accessories

[*] Balanced the value of some skills

[*] Improved the experience of some operations

[*] Fixed a few issues that caused the game to crash during some battles

[*] Fixed the display problem caused by the invasion animation

[*] Fixed the display problem of refreshing text description

[*] Fixed the problem that warehouse items could not be stacked normally

[*] Fixed the problem of invalid traits

[*] Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash when using the lottery machine

[*] Fixed the display problems of some skills when upgrading

[*] Fixed the refresh problem of random events

[*] Improved the description of some accessories

[*] Improved the description of random events
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/763026b8b4b6583409b18a3717114e65ddac6de6.png[/img]

Finally, thank all the friends who support us, and we can only strive to make better games to prove ourselves. You guys will always be the source of our persistence. I hope we can successfully survive this financial crisis and continue to make games for you guys in the future!

notes.title: 2.0 ALL NEW CHAPTER ONLINE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/099c162030bbc20d6670f437d626d050514ae011.jpg[/img]

Hello, Dungeon Warriors!

A new adventure is waiting for you!

The contents of this major update:

[list]
[*] All-new desert chapters

[*] All-new stories

[*] New level (The limit is increased to 20)

[*] Arena is now open
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Let us have a glance, what are the new things?

[h3]NEW DESERT CHAPTERS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/62fde18d39070fc5575f478c05f0847d0ff04988.png[/img]

Countless monsters hid in this strange desert of endless night. Those who once resided here have long since moved; the only ones who now dwell here were the adventurers and a few crazed survivors. As we went deeper into the heart of the desert, the true faces of the bandits were gradually revealed. What was the purpose of this group of cultists who served the so-called Supreme God?

[h3]NEW BATTLE BACKGROUND[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/d384b251fd4761aae082c417475fa56c65d709ea.png[/img]

[h3]NEW MONSTERS & BOSS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/c8cdad169364967f313d84f6b10218d7d4fc6501.jpg[/img]

[h3]NEW ARENA[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/6977deb5708195316123ab9e03e97210564c4bae.png[/img]

[h3]NEW CHALLENGES & REWARDS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/66b414b2c858f672b9cf68fee9dc6bbb81b09ab1.jpg[/img]

[h3]NEW STORY LINE[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/57c46351116401e528663a0e934af660b99300fb.png[/img]

[h3]NEW STORY FRAGMENTS (Battle Drops)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/7d23995bda665efeabaa97e2b49101b68bcbda06.png[/img]

Cefery·Brightwood was born in the Kingdom of Faeronto, the most pious country of faith in Rigos, she was the only child of archbishop Brightwood and grew up under the shadow of her father. Under the strict guidance of the family, she quickly mastered the theological knowledge and the power of faith. At a young age, little Cefery had already reached a height far beyond that of ordinary people to become a qualified High Priest. Just as her future seemed so bright and hopeful...

Interpret the whole world through story fragments, more stories, more lives!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/12790571a7d8877fa0657bc2e0ba15eedfe52bdb.png[/img]

notes.title: Major Update 04.13.2021
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/2fad5b65985bb91afdd6d8131d29a019101fc970.png[/img]

Hello, Dungeon Warriors!

[b]Dungeon No Dungeon[/b] is still in the advanced optimization stage of the EA, and there is a certain distance from the finished version of our goal. Of course, this is not only referred to the lack of content in the current version, but also includes changes to the entire numerical system, a lot of interface rework, many UI, effect, and UE improvements, etc.

We will continue to update the above plan in the future. Although we only have four people, we will make every effort to make sure all the plans come true ASAP. Moreover, it is normal for the current version to have major changes in content, image, and design. We will do our best to protect your saves, but we also hope that you can understand that there may be changes and problems in the game in the future.

Secondly, regarding the version progress, the update of new chapters, new bosses, and new characters is currently estimated to be completed within 2 to 3 months. Thank you for your patience! In addition, while making new content, we will also continue to update some reworked content, optimized experiences, and resolved problems of the game.

New content coming soon:
[list]
[*]  Two new chapters

[*]  All-new monsters

[*]  All-new bosses

[*]  All-new battle mechanism

[*]  All-new system
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: We are so sorry! (Update Log 03.08.2021)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/25dad01b8efacbd1a6586424db3af5f5da78bb0c.png[/img]

Hey, everyone!
It's me, Dungeon No Dungeon's creator, [b]Larcen[/b]!
Today I'd like to address each one of the numerous issues that have arisen since going online.

First off, let me offer my sincerest apologies!
We're deeply sorry that so many of you, who've offered us your trust and support, have encountered a whole host of issues right after launch. We were suddenly hit by a wave of feedback concerning these problems, the vast majority of which hadn't even cropped up at all in our previous rounds of testing. As such, we've been stretched to our limits as we try and stay on top of it all. However, please rest assured that everything is being done to ensure these issues are tackled appropriately, and we're working tirelessly to improve your gaming experience.

The following measures are being taken to solve the difficulties being faced at present:
[olist]
[*]Over the next several weeks we will be sorting together and solving the problems existent today, and improving the game as fast as we can.
[*]We'll be prioritizing key issues that have the biggest impact on your overall experience.
[*]Problems with resolution and windowed mode will be dealt with as soon as possible.
[*]We'll also be coming up with improvements and conducting testing to address the feedback we've received stating that the difficulty needs to be adjusted.
[*]We will be making our [b]paid DLC Dungeon No Dungeon: Blood Knight completely free[/b], and asking Steam to [b]offer full refunds to all who have purchased it[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/294e609994570ea16b94b6f3e765db0713326e4d.png[/img]
        (Since Steam requires [b]at least 30 days period[/b] to change it to free,
         We will [b]temporarily remove Dungeon No Dungeon: Blood Knight DLC from the store page[/b] until it changed to free, and offering a full refund to whoever bought it when Steam allowed.) 
[*]We promise that no paid DLC will appear in the game until it leaves early access.[/olist]

Also, to express our apology: 
[olist]
[*]We'd like to present you all with a free HD wallpaper; available via the following link:
https://mega.nz/file/jggWkBiS#2RQMwf6xAsqOAnTIT2mz_Eq34TXV8DdKVzpGz5FyVKk
[*]All backers will receive a free key for the Blood Knight DLC today.[/olist]

We'll listen carefully to every suggestion you've got for us, fix every bug we can, and improve anything and everything that needs it. And that's the way it'll stay—we'll keep working to polish our game until you're all satisfied. To tell the truth, given that this is our first foray into game creation, we were at a loss as to what to do when faced with so much criticism, blame, and disapproval. It hit us like a bucket of cold water: a shock, but a welcome wake-up call to the fact that there are many areas in which we're lacking, and still need to keep working on! We'll keep on doing our best, and thank each and every one of you for your feedback. Don't lost faith in us, we'll keep forging on ahead!


Wishing you all the best,
Larcen.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: Some Pre-EA Sentiments
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/923e1587df43f2c0c49016ccb2f77f8982f3f789.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/6307f351985dce90cb2912b61a3172a8afa91389.png[/img]

I'm sincerely grateful for each and every one of you and your continued support and patience. With this update, I'd like to express my heartfelt thanks and tell you a little about myself, too.

The quality of our team has maintained the same, as we've worked from nothing to what we have today; whether in terms of game production or mutual cooperation. It's true that we've been through a whole lot of difficulties that might not be apparent to outsiders; learning as we go and hitting the ground running even when we're not sure how to proceed. We weren't taught any of this—and so have had to take it all on with a brave face (and little else). Despite the various bumps in the road, it's always been an enjoyable journey: following our dreams and helping make others happy is why we started this, and why we're keeping at it. The obstacles we've faced forced us to come up with solutions, and are important milestones for us, making us into what we are today. It's true—our dedicated team of rookie 90s kids sure has grown a whole lot in a short space of time. Sticking to what we've always set out to do has always been our motto; making a great game. And that's what keeps us going as we work to make our vision for Dungeon No Dungeon come to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/26a4528dba5ee84ece0f6aee159363ed5de3cd6d.png[/img]

As you all know, our final Early Access release date has been set to March 5th, 2021 at 18:00 PST, for a multitude of reasons. But please don't let the fact that we're releasing into Early Access ahead of schedule concern you! Rest assured that we're still sticking to our promises and will do everything we can to meet your expectations for us. In addition to this, all crowdfunded custom content will continue and be completed according to our original plans. Custom content will be created based on when your order was submitted, on a first-come, first-served basis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/82bcb5ac907549df815daa9123fad66ce055df36.png[/img]

For whatever reason, I'm actually feeling quite sentimental all of a sudden today. I do hope you'll forgive me for being so wordy on the topic, but after these two grueling years we've finally brought Dungeon No Dungeon to a stage where we're happy to bring it online into Early Access. Despite this, I can't help but feel there's still something missing. Perhaps it's because we're a small team, or rather the criticisms we've heard over the last two days or so: "All this team does is moan about how tough everything is!". It's true that we're always overloaded, and pushing out content in a short space of time is a constant challenge with our limited numbers. However, with so many of you offering us your support and enjoying Dungeon No Dungeon, and joining us in this journey, it's not really so grueling after all. Sometimes it seems like a lonely road, but with you here, we know however tough it may seem it's all worth it in the end.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/c979b84b85fded951f11b7af3c92dd267fb4c29b.png[/img]




Wishing you all the best,
Larcen.

notes.title: Dungeon No Dungeon 102 - Rougelike Elements
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/3f649da2ac4fd62eb7a07244674e4841abab974e.png[/img]

There is a set library of content for each adventure chapter. Although there's no overarching goal of the adventure as such, each expedition route, event, puzzle, and challenge throughout the journey will be completely random, which means that the player will have a totally different experience with every expedition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/7f2acf129aeaa49d93dc4769c3d2d8579b20890b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/908790e88c025e1ecfb99de2cd5073ef521fabac.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/bdc3f3f9186c12da9ef50adeba2a6ab53bd50280.png[/img]

Every battle will prevent its own challenges, and require the player to make careful and strategic decisions. Perhaps you're on cloud nine having defeated a horde of powerful enemies. Yet in your next encounter, a weaker monster might be waiting to teach you a hard lesson in humility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/235dcb006a5a6eeceb140387bad633fff969dc36.png[/img]

This design is inspired by such games as Dark Souls, in which each win brings an awesome rush of satisfaction, of achievement. Moreover, we're creating an experience that casts aside repetitive gameplay cycles based on killing monsters, finding equipment, and leveling up before starting again… We are developers, but first and foremost, we are also gamers. So, when designing our own game, we don't want to make our players feel like this gameplay cycle is all there is to experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/78992ec2c4e2ae1bd7231b5aea5a60504bb7edca.jpg[/img]

In Dungeon No Dungeon, players can level up their characters to their caps after just a few rounds of expeditions if they wish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/8ac3bdeb48a619664152717abde5415d3a324e13.png[/img]

If a character dies during an expedition, they can't reappear in the current or later expeditions, or show up in the list of adventurers to add to the team, but the player won't lose that character. They may be revived at the altar in an Lv.1 form, or with their level intact by spending rare resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/f86d05709dcb8bc3649b27cfb7b1d9aeddc8f92a.png[/img]

In Dungeon No Dungeon, acquiring a character takes a certain amount of effort, and sometimes there will be conditions to met too. A single character can have a lot of development potential. Unlike other Roguelikes that grant easily-obtained characters right from the start, DND won't make the death of characters permanent, unless you never revive them, that is.

notes.title: Dungeon No Dungeon 101 - The Board Game
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/2a94e72b364b775bfba7b402448afb97e21675dd.png[/img]

The idea for [b]Dungeon No Dungeon[/b] came from a board game project. Besides our development of the game on Steam, the board game version is also a project we've got in the pipeline. 

However, right now, we are facing several practical problems: First, we are in need of more resources, time, and energy. With so many projects on our plate, we're hard-pushed to make our limited resources be used where they count most. Second, instead of making a stand-alone board game, we'd like for the board game version of [b]Dungeon No Dungeon[/b] to be able to interact and connect with the Steam and iOS versions too. While developing the Steam game, we also made early plans and designs for some of the interactive features in the board game.

[previewyoutube=zxbkLF6WSwI;full][/previewyoutube]

The board game will use dice and game pieces, and according to the number of participants, physical maps of different sizes. 

In future expansions, there will be custom-made maps depending on how many people are playing. New board game characters and map expansions are planned to be released through the game store when added to the Steam and iOS versions. The game supports 2+ players, with one taking on the role of an adventurer and the other the dungeon master. At the most, it will support 7 players: 2 adventure teams and 1 dungeon master, with 3 players on each team. The game will be mainly focused on adventuring, but we are still working on designing advanced gameplay details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/260f434a8ece82c676572467e83657480be4d660.png[/img]

That is all we can reveal about the board game for now. Please follow our update notices if you are interested in its development. We will release new information detailing our exciting progress whenever possible.

notes.title: A Letter To The Players
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/33e7dfd04e3694d36023cad818074b3fdab51392.png[/img]

In the past few months, we've added more random events and in-game items to complement the pre-existing content. We've further optimized the UI and values, which ended up requiring a lot more work than the content that was planned originally. And in August, we ran into technical problems while working to integrate the combat and travelling systems. Some of our team had to leave due to family issues and the stress of the COVID-19 pandemic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/6badd8cc26962c6e4cab41f930ca35e8150d460f.png[/img]

Right now we're short-staffed and, in a way, lacking the battle power we had in the past. Despite this our team has been working around the clock to speed things up. Even so, we have no choice but to extend our deadlines, delaying our Steam Early Access release date. For that, we are deeply and sincerely sorry! We had originally decided, on a whim, to enter Early Access on the 5th of September. In hindsight, this was too optimistic. The current version is still lacking detail and needs more content added, so we will decide our official release date based on our actual development progress.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/302games/dungeon-no-dungeon-0?ref=discovery&term=dungeon%20no%20dungeon][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37888989/1b626ca2aea45137982b465bf9bd0a741b4c856b.png[/img][/url]

In addition, we are in talks with several distribution companies, and hope to reach a result that leaves all parties happy when we finally present the final version of Dungeon No Dungeon to you all. Your understanding and patience are greatly appreciated.

We will fix all current problems and enter into Early Access as soon as possible! <3
